components.name: ap
components.purpose: The ap command: stages, the gate, reviews, units, delivery and store reads.

components.name: secret-scan
components.purpose: The scan of a unit head's added lines for a secret: five forms, admissions in the page's notes, one path at a time.

components.name: crates
components.purpose: The Cargo workspace's crates: the ap crate.

components.name: repo-files
components.purpose: The repository check and the workspace manifests at the root.

components.name: ci
components.purpose: The content and suite checks that ./check runs without a Rust build, and its choice of the pinned engine (ci/engine-pin.sh).

components.name: content
components.purpose: The shared instructions every coding CLI loads, with their checksums.

components.name: deploy
components.purpose: The timers and service files of ap deliver, the quota pass, ap work and the store's backup.

components.name: evals
components.purpose: The evaluation suites and the cost read-out; the routing suite's Muse readers (muse-ember, ember-yolo, ember-route, ember-pack) and its bars verb.

components.name: github-settings
components.purpose: The rulesets and repository settings, compared and applied as files.

components.name: ontology
components.purpose: The work schema, its rehearsal and the pinned engine revision.

components.name: scripts
components.purpose: The install, backup and PC pull steps, and their tests.

components.name: specs
components.purpose: The specifications of the ap contracts.

components.name: route
components.purpose: ap route index, the function route over sections and components, its timer and its evaluation.

components.name: clause
components.purpose: ap clause index and the function clause: the numbered sentences of the specifications with the tests that cite them and the units that name them, and its timer.

components.name: resource
components.purpose: ap resource and the functions capacity and gate: the hosts, accounts, samples and checks of the store, the timer of the pass, and what can start now and where.

components.name: api
components.purpose: ap api batch and the function api_spend: the API credit's admission by the worst case, its reservation and settlement as a run of role batch.

components.name: measure
components.purpose: ap measure sessions and the functions cost, flow and share: each session of the platform's agents as a run with its spend by UTC day, and a window's cost.

components.name: door
components.purpose: The door of a stage with limits: ap check on the PC and the function route from inside the stage, its record, and ap fn.

components.name: egress
components.purpose: The proxy of a stage with limits: the allow-list by name of its network, resolved and connected outside it, and its record.

components.name: pc-side
components.purpose: The fixed programs ap sends to the PC: the side of ap check, of a look on the PC and the look's proxy.

components.name: page-writer
components.purpose: ap unit write: the writer of a unit's page as a stage of ap run, its amendment bounded by the write set and applied as ap unit amend, then reviewed.

components.name: cases
components.purpose: Eval cases as store objects with the files that serve them: index, lost, select and reproduce, so a content unit's gate runs only the cases it reaches.

components.name: github-config
components.purpose: The continuous-integration workflow and ownership files.

components.name: roles
components.purpose: The roles of the work schema's grants, the role each verb and service claims, and the roles file.
